text:
ryan.fong: flagging an odd revrec hit from yesterday's billing run. Resync Labs (contract RS-502-01) shows $27,900 of prepaid revenue recognized this month that should've remained deferred. Invoices INV-2050-5001 & INV-2050-5002.

sandra.mills: can you summarize how it happened?

ryan.fong: short version: partner commission rebate (REBATE-PRT-77) was posted as a negative revenue invoice line and the proration engine treated it as a decrease in outstanding deferred balance, accelerating recognition. It should have been booked to a contra-liability (commissions payable) not netted against deferred revenue.

jorge.ramirez: ugh. do you have the SQL to trace the invoice lines? I'll pull the GL after.

ryan.fong: pasted query: ```sql
SELECT il.invoice_id, il.line_type, il.amount, il.description
FROM billing.invoice_lines il
JOIN billing.invoices i on il.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.contract_id='RS-502-01' AND i.posted_date >= '2025-05-01'
ORDER BY i.posted_date;
```

billing-bot: billing-bot: JOB LOG 1912342000: billing-run applied partner rebate REBATE-PRT-77 against invoices INV-2050-5001/5002. Log: /var/log/billing/run/1912342000.log

elaine.ops: propose reversing JE: debit Revenue (GL 4000) $27,900; credit Deferred Revenue (GL 2005) $27,900. Memo: "Correction: partner rebate misposted as negative deferred reduction on RS-502-01; move back to Deferred Rev." Need approval and JE posted before month close.

jorge.ramirez: approve. Please include supporting worksheet and billing log link in the JE notes. Also let's tag accounting policy — commissions vs rebate posting entry.

sandra.mills: uploaded worksheet: https://redwood-internal.s3/finance/RS-502-01_rebate_analysis.csv

ryan.fong: quick calc in sheet: prepaid total 150,000; ledger recognized this period 77,900; expected recognized 50,000; over-recognized = 27,900.

elaine.ops: creating JE now JE# 2050-MAY-REB-003 (pending). Attachment list includes invoice ids, billing run log, and worksheet.

jorge.ramirez: I'll open a dev ticket to change posting behavior: rebate lines tagged as partner_commission should be routed to commissions payable GL and explicitly excluded from proration math. Creating BE-4899 and assigning to jorge.ramirez.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED BE-4899 - Route partner rebates to payable GL and exclude from proration. Assigned jorge.ramirez.

cfo_lucas: For the close pack: include JE number, ARR/NRR impact, and a one-line note on policy change. Also run a sweep for rebate-tagged lines in the month to estimate total exposure.

jorge.ramirez: quick sweep returned 3 other contracts with similar posting (estimated exposure ~$64k). I'll run full reconciliation tomorrow and add to the ticket.

elaine.ops: JE posted. Posted note: JE# 2050-MAY-REB-003; debit Rev GL 4000 $27,900; credit Deferred Rev GL 2005 $27,900. Deferred schedule updated and attached to month close pack.

ryan.fong: thanks all. Sandra/Jorge please include remediation steps and test cases for BE-4899.

sandra.mills: will add tests and sample data. thanks :thumbsup:
